posts.title: My Three Words for 2026
posts.description: Running a bit late on my 2025 reflection and sharing My Three words for 2026. This year is all about preparing for the future and the changes that I know are planned for next year. It’s all about my mindset, business, approach to life and concepts of self.

posts.title: My New Book is Here - plus a New Freebie for You
posts.description: My new book - Draw It Simple - has arrived. To celebrate the launch, I’ve got a new freebie in the subscriber resources. It includes some pointer for drawing things simply and a couple of step-by-step things to draw.

posts.title: I’m Publishing a New Book! Not the One You Might Think
posts.description: I’ve written and drawn a new book about how to draw simple and effective things for visual notetaking. I’m really excited about this one - and a little scared.
